integrity: The proof is analytic and self-contained once the standard PGF root-factorization identity for the variance is derived. No finite computation is used as a substitute for the quantified argument.
limitations: The result is restricted to probability-generating zeros in the closed left half-plane and an annulus \(R^{-1}\le|\zeta|\le R\); it does not solve the sharp constant for narrower excluded sectors. Exact attainment of the imaginary-axis branch is exhibited for even degrees.
title: Sharp variance envelope for annular left-half-plane PGF zeros
